description: Unit test class for KeyLoader, verifying key and certificate loading functionalities in various scenarios.

classes.name: KeyLoaderTest
classes.description: Test suite for verifying the behavior of the KeyLoader utility in different key/cert file loading scenarios.

methods.name: testLoaderSucceedsForExistingKeyStore
methods.description: Checks that a valid P12 keystore can be loaded successfully, and keys are not null.

methods.name: testLoaderFailsForNonExistingKeyStore
methods.description: Ensures loading a non-existing keystore throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: testLoaderSucceedsForExistingKeyAndCertFiles
methods.description: Validates loading of private key and certificate chain from PEM files.

methods.name: testLoaderSucceedsForExistingKeyFile
methods.description: Checks that a private key can be loaded from a PEM file alone.

methods.name: testLoaderSucceedsForExistingCertFile
methods.description: Checks that a certificate can be loaded from a PEM file alone, and matches the public key.

methods.name: testLoaderFailsForNonExistingKeyFile
methods.description: Ensures that loading a non-existing private key PEM file raises an exception.

methods.name: testLoaderFailsForNonExistingCertFile
methods.description: Ensures that loading a non-existing certificate PEM file raises an exception.

methods.name: testLoaderPkcs1PrivateKey
methods.description: Tests loading a private key in PKCS#1 format from PEM file.
